description: This file contains utility functions for formatting numeric values, including general value formatting and spend-specific formatting with currency symbols.

methods.name: valueFormatter
methods.description: Formats a number into a string with shorthand notation, appending 'M' for millions and 'k' for thousands.

methods.name: valueFormatterSpend
methods.description: Formats a number as a currency string, appending 'M' or 'k' with a dollar sign for large values.
